transformations: Greek Unicode and source token order preserved without normalization; punctuation remains attached as supplied.
MorphGNT word IDs derived from source BCV plus one-based verse word position; seven original columns retained.
Rahlfs IDs derived from artifact witness, source book number, chapter, verse and unit position. Source i/br markup retained in records; italic markers displayed literally.
Rahlfs MyBible numeric verse mapping is used as supplied, without mapping to Hebrew, other Greek witnesses, or CATSS subverse identifiers. Nonmonotonic source reference order is retained.
Only documented lexical links are followed. Missing mappings and ambiguous STEP entries remain explicit. STEP Meaning and Open Scriptures definitions excluded.
